svg.title: Train information returns as a range while Ghori lies across both platform arrows.
svg.desc: The restored signboard and manual call sheet agree on a train-time range but not the platform. Babul-da compares them, Cecil reports visible uncertainty and Ghori lies across both blank arrow spaces.
svg.text: Page 59, panel 3 · Wide platform view beneath the two station clocks

text.tspan: Useful train information returns as a range rather
than a false precise platform claim.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
